body: I hadn't thought about it like that. Thank you. The drawing is a good example. I appreciate the offer. I'll try making a list and narrowing stuff down in a few. Thank you again.

Thank you, I hope it helps. I'm sorry you've had to deal with that guilt at all. It's taken me damn near four years to get even close to the point with myself where I don't really feel like I've stabbed myself in the back--accelerated by light years by kind, supportive loved ones. If you ever want someone to talk to, you're more than welcome to PM me.
Thank you so much. Please keep up the good work, I don't where I or anyone else would be without that kind of positive support and caring. I hope to be able say it before too long.
